text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What should I do for my next stream~? We 
just did brainstorming merch together 
recently, so...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, 'I want to watch a serious fighting 
game stream.' 'Aren't you gonna do a 
drawing stream, Love-chan? I want to see 
that charming art of yours again.'――

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it sounds fun, but... I don't want it 
to just be a one-way broadcast, you know?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Giving love, and receiving love. 
Interacting with everyone and having fun 
is what my streams are all about♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Then taking everyone's feedback into 
account—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Serious Party Game Showdown! I'll draw 
whatever the winner requests♡" —All right, 
this should be fun for everyone♪
